notablePrerequisites: Vorapede does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Vorapede, adding {C}{C}.
Vorapede dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Vorapede trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Vorapede, giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
